method: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of 23 NOAA LOOFS surface model nowcast snapshots every six hours from October 12 00:00 through October 17 12:00 UTC 2026, chosen to match the archived OHPS and STLE200 period. Eastward and northward velocity components averaged separately; temperature averaged separately. Only values valid in every sample retained. Fixed sampled week-to-date mean, not a climatology.
